scope: Discover city, choose build, enter arcade, earn supplies, return, build, restore

findings.issue: First visit exposed a naming form with no visible neighborhood
findings.fix: Reuse existing home, court and garden artwork and explain starter home and optional saves.

findings.issue: Homepage city invitation was below the arcade cabinets
findings.fix: Move the new-player invitation and returning-player city card above cabinets.

findings.issue: Builder arcade intent and shared selected goal could disagree
findings.fix: Persist the chosen goal from placement and arcade launch; carry the requested block on return.

findings.issue: Next arcade build was buried under simulation management
findings.fix: Show a project selector, visible resource progress, resident outcome and direct play/build action.

findings.issue: Per-visit receipt omitted fractional court progress and Housing Stack had no shared receipt
findings.fix: Calculate receipts from lifetime earnings including quarter points; show shared objective across all five games and add Housing Stack result receipt.

findings.issue: Arcade recommendations parsed unrelated simulation goal copy
findings.fix: Recommend games using actual selected project resource deficits.

verification.browser: Chrome at 430px phone width; desktop source and earlier layout audit
checked: Fresh city creation and starter home placement
Court objective travels from builder to VOTE and back
All five game routes expose expected selected objective and correct resource requirements
Local fixture using production award() -> +12 court points return receipt -> court placement on plot 2 -> court persists after reload
Fresh onboarding artwork and mobile panel layout
Node checks: all resource paths, fractional rewards, duplicate protection, spent-vs-earned receipts, chosen goal backup/restore
